mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 8.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 3.5%, the Fed is perceived as behind the curve, causing negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 8.0% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) fails to produce negative returns in > 50% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve's expected tightening leads to negative S&P 500 returns over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to predict negative 5d returns in > 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1.4 million units indicate a contracting housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 35% of instances when HOUST < 1.4, or t-test p > 0.1 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous cooling in the labor market (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 3.5%) signals an impending recession, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 3.5%) fails to produce negative returns in > 50% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms, producing negative returns over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
